description.title: חרגות פוליסה
description.summary: This table details exclusions to the 'Mekhalel' business insurance policy. It lists events and actions that are not covered by the policy, such as acts of war, terrorism, and government confiscation.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת חריגות לפוליסת ביטוח 'מכלול' לעסק. היא מפרטת אירועים ופעולות שאינם מכוסים על ידי הפוליסה, כגון מעשי מלחמה, טרור והפקעות ממשלתיות. ניתן לחפש חריגות ספציפיות לפי סעיף או תיאור האירוע. החריגות כוללות מלחמה, פעולות טרור, הפקעות, נזקים כתוצאה מפעולות ממשלתיות, התפרעויות אזרחיות, ושיבוש מערכות תקשורת. הפוליסה 'מכלול' אינה מכסה נזקים הנגרמים כתוצאה מאירועים אלו. סעיפים 2.1, 2.2, 2.3 ו-2.4 מפרטים את סוגי האירועים הלא מכוסים.

sketch:
2.1 War, invasion, act of a foreign enemy, hostilities and/or quasi-warlike actions (whether war is been declared or not).
2.2 Civil war, insurrection, riots, civil commotion amounting to popular uprising, military insurrection, rebellion, revolution, usurpation of power by the military, declaration of military rule and/or siege and/or any activity which constitutes declaration or existence of martial law.
2.3 Confiscation, nationalization, expropriation and/or destruction and/or damage to property, by or at the order of a government and/or national or municipal authority.
2.4 Any act of terrorism - for the purpose of this paragraph "act of terrorism" shall mean: an act which includes, however is not limited to use of force, violence, the use of any weapon - including atomic, chemical or biological, weapons of mass destruction - destruction, disruption and/or subversion of any communication and information system and/or infrastructure and/or whomsoever is included therein; sabotage or use of any other means in order to cause damage of any type, whether intentionally or unintentionally; or any threat to initiate any of the actions noted above by any person or group/s, whether acting alone or on behalf of- or in connection with any organization formed for political, religious, ideological or similar purposes, including the intention to influence or any government, or to intimidate the public or any part thereof.

payload:
טבלה: חרגות פוליסה
This table details exclusions to the 'Mekhalel' business insurance policy. It lists events and actions that are not covered by the policy, such as acts of war, terrorism, and government confiscation.
ממדים: exclusion type, description

2.1 War, invasion, act of a foreign enemy, hostilities and/or quasi-warlike actions (whether war is been declared or not).
2.2 Civil war, insurrection, riots, civil commotion amounting to popular uprising, military insurrection, rebellion, revolution, usurpation of power by the military, declaration of military rule and/or siege and/or any activity which constitutes declaration or existence of martial law.
2.3 Confiscation, nationalization, expropriation and/or destruction and/or damage to property, by or at the order of a government and/or national or municipal authority.
2.4 Any act of terrorism - for the purpose of this paragraph "act of terrorism" shall mean: an act which includes, however is not limited to use of force, violence, the use of any weapon - including atomic, chemical or biological, weapons of mass destruction - destruction, disruption and/or subversion of any communication and information system and/or infrastructure and/or whomsoever is included therein; sabotage or use of any other means in order to cause damage of any type, whether intentionally or unintentionally; or any threat to initiate any of the actions noted above by any person or group/s, whether acting alone or on behalf of- or in connection with any organization formed for political, religious, ideological or similar purposes, including the intention to influence or any government, or to intimidate the public or any part thereof.
